name: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion
doc: 2D Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion PDE on a 512x288 ping-pong grid with gradient-lit bioluminescent coral shading. Bass and mids steer feed/kill morphogenesis; onsets seed glowing chemical rings and pulse the field.

palette.doc: OKLab palette mapped across chemical V concentration and ridge glow

pulse.doc: radial onset advection and ring-seeding strength

relief.doc: 3D ridge shading and specular rim intensity

swirl.doc: gentle curl drift keeping the colony alive
